subject: MAP: Phased exchange & timeboxed use policy for assessment materials
body:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@brightretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Phased exchange & timeboxed use policy for assessment materials

Elena —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our call, attached is a minimal Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the first tranche of evaluation artifacts so your ML team can begin a short smoke-run. High level: we propose a two-phase handoff with clear usage constraints and an acceptance gate at the end of Phase 2.

Phase 1 (private sandbox, 10 business days)
- Deliverables: Assessment_SeedSet_v1.zip, PromptPack_v1.pdf
- Use: inference-only, no re‑distribution, no model fine-tuning
- Access: ephemeral credentials; logs retained for 30 days; access revoked after sandbox window
- Success gate: basic coverage report + 1 performance regression check

Phase 2 (expanded pilot, 20 business days)
- Deliverables: expanded testcases, licensed prompt variations (provisional)
- Use: evaluation + telemetry collection for quality metrics (precision/recall on defined prompt sets)
- Restrictions: results may be used internally for product evaluation only; any external benchmarking or dataset publication requires prior written consent
- Success gate: joined acceptance demo and signed close memo; optional escrow for prompt artifacts if requested

Key asks from BrightRetail
1) Confirm the Phase 1 start date (we suggest 2026-05-25)
2) Confirm procurement contact for the MAP signature (CC'd procurement ok)
3) A single point of contact for telemetry questions during the sandbox (who on your side will troubleshoot tokenization/format mismatches)

Attachments: MAP_TermSheet_20260519.pdf (term-sheet), Assessment_SeedSet_v1.zip (zip, ~120MB), PromptPack_v1.pdf (doc)

Next steps: if this looks good we'll: (a) lock the start date, (b) push credentials to your SRE, and (c) schedule a 30‑minute kickoff with Karthik and Marissa for ops/legal alignment.

Cheers,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.ai

---

From: Elena Park <elena@brightretail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightretail.com
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Phased exchange & timeboxed use policy for assessment materials

Thanks Jordan — this is helpful. A few quick clarifications:
- Phase 1 start: 2026-05-26 would be better for our infra calendar.
- Can you confirm whether the sandbox credentials will be IP-restricted to our corporate IP range? We have strict egress policies.
- On restrictions: BrightRetail legal will need the clause that forbids publishing derived datasets (we can share language).

I'll loop in procurement and legal once we align on the start and the IP controls.

Best,
Elena
Elena Park
Head of ML Ops, BrightRetail
elena@brightretail.com

---

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@brightretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Phased exchange & timeboxed use policy for assessment materials

Elena — thanks. Quick replies inline: 
- Start date: happy to move Phase 1 to 2026-05-26 — we'll update the MAP doc.
- IP restriction: yes, we can bind sandbox credentials to an IP allowlist. Karthik will send the exact format we need.
- Publication clause: agreed — Marissa, can you attach the standard non-publication paragraph and confirm if escrow language is needed for the prompt variations?

Karthik, Marissa — can you prepare: (1) the IP allowlist template, (2) a short telemetry data schema we'll keep for audit, and (3) the non‑publication paragraph so BrightRetail legal can sign off quickly?

Jordan

---

On Mon, 1 Jun 2026 at 09:03 Elena Park <elena@brightretail.com> wrote:
> Jordan / team — we have procurement questions and one requested redline to the MAP term sheet (section 3.2: destruction clause). Procurement asks for a short attestation that artifacts were destroyed within 10 business days of termination and a straightforward audit trail.
> 
> Is that acceptable? Also — we want the Phase 2 telemetry retention reduced to 45 days (from the 90 listed).
> 
> Elena

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@brightretail.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Phased exchange & timeboxed use policy for assessment materials

Elena — appreciate the redline. Headline answers below: 
- Destruction attestation: acceptable. We'll add a simple certificate-of-destruction template to the MAP that your procurement can sign — it attests destruction within 10 business days and references our audit log export.
- Telemetry retention: we can accept 45 days for Phase 2 telemetry (we'll update the MAP). Note: longer retention is recommended for regression analysis, but we can proceed with 45 days for the pilot.

I've attached the updated MAP term sheet with both edits and a short certificate-of-destruction template. Jordan / Karthik — please prepare the IP allowlist template and the telemetry schema; once those are ready Elena can circulate to procurement/legal for signature.

Attachments: MAP_TermSheet_20260519.pdf (updated), Certificate_of_Destruction_Template.docx

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Head of Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

[End of thread]
